items.title: Spencer Jakab | Why Auto Parts Retailers Might Be Worth a Look
items.summary: O’Reilly Automotive and AutoZone’s recent slumps leave them at modest premiums to their respective trailing 10-year averages of price to forward sales. Investors aren’t being offered quite the same bargains as they saw in auto-parts retailers back in 2008, but it’s time to start kicking the tires on the stocks.

items.title: Auto Parts Retailers Can Turn the Corner
items.summary: If investors were asked a year ago to guess the most successful consumer stock since the global financial crisis, many would have said Apple.  AutoZone  which releases results tomorrow, was close behind.  The performance of those retailers was driven by smart financial stewardship and the resilience of their business models.
